rows.reason: The squared automation button (stable): on, variant (square or flat), orientation (horizontal, verticalRight, verticalLeft), the readout stack, the alert frame and flap, badges and progress. It fits with a value map (library regular to element square; library vertical to orientation verticalRight) and the module's tables.

A straight bar (beta): label, size (small or medium), variant (regular, enhanced or medium), tint and vertical. It fits straight bars, with a new descriptor form and a dashed cue for the dead state; corners need the pinned line elements.

The process symbol holder (stable) with the pinned generator icons in dist/icons fits the generator symbol, with new wrapper code that places the icon element in the button's icon slots. A module-first upgrade of a library kind, not the closing of a gap (ruling RW-01).

The button (stable): variant, disabled, a label slot and a click event. It is the candidate for a command button, with a new event entry in the wrapper; the automation button is a process symbol holder with no label and does not fit.

rejected.reason: A module of SVG helpers, not an element: no pinned element draws a normal band and limit marks.
An experimental radial load gauge: a different information type from the library's engine and alternator picture.
A 48 px glyph on LitElement with no on state, tag, readout stack, badges or alert frame; obc-automation-button with the pinned generator icons fits instead.
